results.title: LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila
results.content: Leaders and representatives of the 11 members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and their allies, are gathering in Manila for the bloc's biggest event of the year

results.title: Spy scandal, US midterm defeat heat up Trump’s Asia visit
results.content: Trump will first visit Manila for meetings with Southeast Asian and other regional leaders on Tuesday before jetting to Shenzhen for the APEC forum, where he will meet the Chinese president and hold three-way discussions with Xi and Russia's Vladimir Putin

results.title: Trump says he might meet with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un in China
results.content: Trump says while departing the White House en route to the Philippines and China that any meeting would occur in China, and that the North Korean leader's presence was ultimately up to Chinese President Xi Jinping
